description: Check a counterparty before you pay or accept a deal. Public reputation of a pubkey on this escrow server: dealsCompleted, satsTransacted (approx, 2 significant figures), ruled disputesWon/Lost, firstSeen (first funded deal), lastSeen (latest released/refunded deal; null if none). Funded deals only. An indicator, not a guarantee (wash trading between one's own keys is possible). escrow_show/escrow_status/escrow_accept include the counterparty's automatically
name: escrow_reputation
